source_rows.title: Queued MP prefetch waits for poll timeout after reader release
source_rows.reason: Source supports a CPU-only retained-budget notification lead. The controller multiplexes requests on one background thread and polls at 500 ms. No installed matching LMCache/native Bitmap/StorageManager runtime was located in the workspace cache; do not replace them with a hand-written poll model. Requires an attached filesystem L2 because the no-L2 path completes synchronously. No local latency reproduction or CoroPerf gain is established.
source_rows.reason_zh: 源码支持 CPU 上的预算释放通知线索：多个预取请求共享后台线程，轮询间隔为 500ms。工作区缓存未找到匹配的 LMCache/native Bitmap/StorageManager 运行环境；不能用自写轮询模型替代。必须挂载文件系统 L2，否则无 L2 路径会同步完成。尚未本地验证延迟或 CoroPerf 增益。
proposed_identity_join: actual poll wake reason and completion
source_rows.native_baseline: Existing MP observability already emits request/session and prefetch events; compare its retained facts before claiming any missing relation. Generic thread ancestry cannot identify each multiplexed request.

source_rows.title: MP request-state retention in client and sidecar
source_rows.reason: The report distinguishes a process-lifetime dedup set from abandoned sidecar prefetch/completion ownership. The first has an explicit source owner and is not a proven lost-caller problem. The second is a conditional lifecycle-history lead. The reported dev 05fc77a plus vLLM MP connector/fs_native sidecar deployment is not prepared; no native memory-growth or CoroPerf result.
source_rows.reason_zh: 报告区分客户端去重集合与 sidecar 预取完成状态的所有权；前者源码所有者已明确，并非已证实的 caller 丢失。后者保留为生命周期历史线索。报告中的 dev 05fc77a、vLLM MP connector 与 fs_native sidecar 未准备，未验证原生内存增长或 CoroPerf 结果。
source_rows.native_baseline: Native request IDs, active_prefetch_jobs and completed_results_count already exist; generic Task creation cannot prove native Bitmap/lock ownership.

source_rows.title: Aborted LMCache sessions and cache request finalization
source_rows.reason: The report is a source/unit-test analysis at 174a5f37b9, explicitly not a production runtime leak observation. Real MP daemon/host hit and abort-before-init_load_back timing are unprepared. Fake connector tests demonstrate a hook-contract gap only and must not be counted as real LMCache lock/session or CoroPerf attribution evidence.
source_rows.reason_zh: 报告基于 174a5f37b9 的源码与单测分析，明确不是生产运行时泄漏观察。真实 MP daemon、host hit 与 init_load_back 前的中止窗口尚未准备；fake connector 单测只能说明 hook 合约缺口，不能计为真实 LMCache 锁、session 或 CoroPerf 归因证据。
source_rows.native_baseline: The issue already lists source paths and ordering. Additional historical per-attempt identity must be measured; a creation stack alone does not establish safe cleanup.
